text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRRAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Little boy!
Look out! Run for it...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そこのキミっ！
危ない、
逃げてっ……！

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: ...Hah.

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRAAAAGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
A whip made of magic...?
Is that boy fighting the monsters?
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔力のムチ……？
魔物と戦ってるの、
あの子……？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: No... That's not it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや……
違うっ！

text_block_list.name: Giant Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRRAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Waahhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃう！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what now?!
That monster just grew really big!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なになにっ！？
魔物がいきなり、
おっきくなっちゃった！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: As he struck the monster with his whip, it grew to great size...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの方の叩いた魔物が、
巨大化したようですが……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
It's not just its body.
Its strength, its magic... They're all powered up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
体格だけじゃないわ……
筋力も魔力も、
だいぶ強化されてる！

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
There's your carrot and your stick.
Now get moving, monster scum...
Turn this city into a giant trash heap!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──アメとムチは、
くれてやったぜ。
さあ行きな、
クソ魔獣ども……
どこもかしこも、
好き放題に荒らしまくれっ！

text_block_list.name: Giant Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRUOOOGGGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: You don't think... that boy set these monsters loose?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしかして、
あの子が町に魔物を放ったの……！？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: A child like him... How in the world?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんな子供が……
いったい、
どうやって！？

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
...Bah.
You're all the same.
There's more to being a grown-up than height, you know!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──ケッ。
どいつもこいつも……
タッパばかりが、
大人と子供の違いってワケでもねーだろが。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Who are you?!
Why are you doing this?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
キミは誰！？
なんでこんなことを！？

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Huhhh? You a moron?
You're about to get murdered,
so what's the point explaining anything?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー……、
バカ？
これからヤられるってのに、
そんなこと聞いて何になるっつーのさ。

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
...Ehhh?
Hang on, those faces... Feels like I've seen you before.
Hmmm...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ぁん？
つーか、
テメーらの顔……
どっかで見たことあるな。
んー……？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Mmmm...?
text_block_list.orig_text: んー……？

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, yeah. Got it.
So you're Akira Mosakuji's Princess Knight and his merry crew.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー
そっか。
テメーらが『模索路晶』のプリンセスナイトと、
その仲間どもか。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text:
He knows not only my lord... but Miss Akira...
Miss Labyrista's true name on top of that...?
Just who could this strange young man be...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
主さまのことだけでなく……
晶さまを、
ラビリスタさまの本当のお名前までも、
知っている……？
いったい、
この方は何者なのでしょう……？

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Y'know, slaughtering you guys
won't win me any extra points or anything...
But I don't need you in my way.
text_block_list.orig_text:
別に、
テメーらをバラしても
オレの『得点』になるってワケじゃないんだが。
……邪魔されてもメンドくせーな。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what?
Little boy... what are you saying?
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なに？
キミ……
何を言ってるの？

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Oh, don't worry. It's real simple.
text_block_list.orig_text:
気にすんな。
簡単な話だ。

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: I'm just gonna get rid of every one of you losers, that's all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
テメーらを、
これからまとめて始末するってだけの話だからよ……！

text_block_list.name: Giant Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRRAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: He strengthened the monsters, and increased their size once more!
text_block_list.orig_text:
また魔物が強化、
巨大化しました……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Hey, Rei... Doesn't that boy's power seem familiar...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
レイちゃん、
あの子の力って
もしかして……！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
It's similar to the power we all know well!
So that's why the beasts all had this strange aura!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ！
彼の……
あの強化能力に似ている！
魔物たちが纏っている妙なオーラは、
それか！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Then that boy... Is he one of the Seven Crowns' Princess Knights?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃああの子も、
【七冠】の誰かのプリンセスナイトなの！？

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Yeah right, you morons!
I don't hang out with that club of old hags and fogeys!
I fight for myself!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハッ！　
バカ言ってんじゃねえ！
【七冠】とかいう、
ジジババの会とは関係ねーよっ。
オレはオレだ！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
\"I fight for myself\"? Bah, you think that sounds cool?!
If you want to leave an impression,
why not start by announcing your name?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
オレはオレだー！　
とか、
カッコつけてんじゃないわよ！
そんなにカッコつけたいんだったら、
高笑いして名乗りでもあげたらどう！？

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: ...Hah.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……フン。

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Die!
text_block_list.orig_text: 死ねっ！

text_block_list.name: Giant Monster
text_block_list.text: GGRUOOOGGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: O-oh crap...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヤ、
ヤバっ……！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh!
Far from harming the beasts, I can barely defend myself!
There must be some way...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……くっ！
攻撃が効かないどころか、
身を守るだけで精一杯だ！
何か手は……！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text:
Miss Pecorine will surely return with aid in time!
Until then, we must focus our efforts on survival!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぺコリーヌさまが、
きっと助勢を連れて戻られるはず！
それまで、
どうにか凌ぐしかありません……！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Agreed!
Even if we can't win, we can't give in!
We mustn't let them ruin the city any more!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだね！
倒せなくっても、
ここで踏ん張ろう！
街にこれ以上被害を出さないためにも！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Aarghh...!
I hate to rely on her for everything, but I guess it's our only shot!
These things are too deadly to even turn tail and run from!
text_block_list.orig_text:
う～っ……！
あいつにこれ以上頼るのはシャクだけど、
それしかないっぽいわね！
逃げるにも、
背中なんて見せてられる余裕ないし！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah!
After all...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うんっ！
だって……！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Oohhh...
text_block_list.orig_text: うぅー……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Standing behind us
are people we absolutely must protect!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わたしたちの後ろには、
守らなくちゃいけないひとたちがいるから！

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
...Hah!
I've barely even gotten started, and already you're desperate!
That old Omniscient Kaiser you beat can't have been worth much!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──ハッ！
まだ始まったばかりだっつーのに、
ずいぶん必死じゃねーか。
テメーらが倒した覇瞳皇帝も、
タカが知れてるってもんだ……！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
...!
Shut it, you little brat!
What would you know about Her Majesty?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ！
黙れ、
このガキ……！
あんたが陛下の何を知ってるってのよ！

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Ehhhh?!
Who's a brat now?!
I'll murder your ass, mangy cat!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああんっ！？
誰がガキだ！
ブチ殺すぞこのクソ猫が！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Whaaa?! [i]You'll[/i] murder [i]me?![/i] 
Don't talk to me like that, you little runt!
Get too cocky, and I'll kill you dead!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ！？　
ブチ殺すですって！？
ふざけんじゃないわよクソチビ！
調子乗ってるとぶっ殺すわよっ！？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
...That boy and Miss Karyl...
They seem a little bit... similar, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
キャルちゃんとあの子、
ちょっと似た者同士
……なのかな？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
This is no time to be trading words of abuse!
Hm...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
口喧嘩など、
している場合じゃないぞ……！
んっ……？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Something rolls along the ground just ahead...
text_block_list.orig_text: 目の前に、何かが転がってきた……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
...Hm?
What did {0} just pick up...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……んっ？
{0}が拾ったソレって……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Is that one of the magic items Peco left behind?
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっきぺコさんが置いて行った、
魔法のアイテム？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaaa?! Mr. Knight?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えええええっ！？　
騎士クンーっ！？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Mr. Knight... swallowed the crystal ball!
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士くんが、
水晶玉を飲み込んじゃったぁ！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text:
You must not, my lord!
Please spit it out!
Go on, spit!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いけません主さま！
ぺっ
してくださいませ！
ぺっ
て！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Knight! Are you OK?!
Umm... umm... What now?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クン、
大丈夫！？
えっとえっと、
どうしよう！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
I haven't learned any spells to make someone spit,
or to control their insides... I'll just have to try my healing!
Mr. Knight, I'm sorry! I'm going to touch your tummy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぺってさせる魔法も、
お腹の中のものを動かす魔法も
まだ勉強してないし……
とりあえず回復魔法を使うしか！
騎士クン、
ごめん！　
ちょっとだけ、
お腹触るねっ……！

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Tch... We're in the middle of a fight.
You tryna make a fool of me?!
Hurry up and crush 'em, monster scum!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちっ、
戦いの最中だっつーのに……
ナメてんのかよテメーら！？
とっとと始末しちまえ、
クソ魔獣ども！

text_block_list.name: Giant Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRRAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori & Rei
text_block_list.text: Waaaghhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: うぁぁああっ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Rei!
Hiyori!
...Huh?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
レイちゃん！
ヒヨリちゃん！
……
えっ！？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: I can't control my magic...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔力が、
コントロールできないっ……！？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Huhhh?!
Wh-what now? What's even happening?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええっ！？
ちょっと何よ、
なにが起きてるっての！？

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Whoaagh?!
What is this? Some kinda flash-bang?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うおぉっ！？
なんだこりゃあ、
目くらましかっ？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Y-Yui?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ゆ、
ユイちゃんっ！？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Yuuu?
text_block_list.orig_text: ゆーっ？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Her body's emitting blinding light...!
What in the world is this phenomenon?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ユイの全身から、
光が……！
いったいなんだ、
この現象はっ！？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
I... I don't know!
Umm... umm... What should I...?
Wahhh?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
わかんないっ！
えっとえっと、
どうすればっ……
わわっ！？

text_block_list.name: Giant Monster
text_block_list.text: GGRUOOOGGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text:
...Ah!
The aura around the monsters has disappeared!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……！
魔物たちを覆っていたオーラが、
消滅いたしました！

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Ehhh?!
The hell's going on?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ！？
どーなってやがる！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
...I don't really get it, but if they're not enhanced,
this has gotta be our chance!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……よくわかんないけど
強化が解けたなら、
これってチャンスだよね！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Agreed!
Let's go, Hiyori!
Gourmet Guild, cover our backs!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ！
いくぞヒヨリ！
【美食殿】、
後詰を頼む！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
S-sure...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ！
は、
はいっ……！

text_block_list.name: All Three
text_block_list.text: Haaaahhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: はあああぁっ！

text_block_list.name: Giant Monster
text_block_list.text: GGRUOOOGGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... They're still not going down!
I suppose their sheer size isn't just for show...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くっ……
まだ仕留められないか！
さすがに巨大なだけあって、
しぶといな……！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
But this is working way better than before!
We can... fight them now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
さっきまでより
ずっと手ごたえあったよ！
これなら、
戦えるっ……！

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Why, you...!
Hey, Arnold!
Get up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
このっ……！
おい
アーノルド！
起きろ！

text_block_list.name: Giant Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRUOOOGHH...
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオ……

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Tch...!
Useless piece of trash!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちっ！
使えねぇやつが……！

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Hey, morons... This isn't over!
I'll be back soon enough!
text_block_list.orig_text:
テメーら……
覚えてやがれ！
すぐ戻ってきてやるからな！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Shaddup!
Don't show your face again, dummy! Lousy runt!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うっさい！
二度と来るんじゃないわよバカ！　
クソチビーっ！

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Ehhhh?!
Who're you calling a—
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああッ！？
誰がクソチビっ……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
...H... huh?
He just vanished...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あ、
あれっ？
消えちゃった……？

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: ...Was that a Spatial Leap, I wonder...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……今のは
……空間跳躍、
でしょうか……？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Whew... Looks like he's withdrawn.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ……
退いてくれたか。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
If your magic hadn't nullified their enhancements, Yui,
this could have gone much worse.
Thank you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ユイの魔法が、
魔物の強化を打ち消してくれなければ
本当に危ないところだったな。
ありがとう。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Yui, when did you learn that spell?
It was amazing! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ユイちゃん、
また新しい魔法を覚えたの？
すごいねっ♪

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
No, no!
I wasn't expecting any of that stuff to happen either!
What on earth was that light...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
違うよっ！？
わたしも、
あんなことになるなんて
思ってもみなくて。
いったい、なんだったんだろう……？

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text:
My lord!
My lord...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
主さまっ。
主さま……？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Ga goo...?
text_block_list.orig_text: だーうー？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Oh—that's right!
Mr. Knight, are you okay...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
そうだっ！
騎士クン、
大丈夫……！？

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text:
...He appears to be fast asleep.
Thanks to your swift healing efforts, Miss Yui,
his improper meal seems to have done little harm.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……眠っておられるだけのようです。
ユイさまが
回復魔法を使ってくれたおかげで、
おかしなものを呑んでしまった影響も無いようで……

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text:
...Eheh.
It is the same sweet sleeping face I have always gazed upon... ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふふ。
いつもと変わらない、
愛らしい寝顔の主さま……♪

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Oh, phew! What a relief...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっかぁ、
良かったぁー……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Yes. But...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
しかし……

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Wahhh! Wahhh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えーん、
えーん……

text_block_list.name: Citizen 1
text_block_list.text: Urgh... Owww...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅ、
いってて……

text_block_list.name: Citizen 2
text_block_list.text:
My house...!
Just when it was finally fixed!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああもう！
ようやく直った家が……！

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: One billion rupies... My entire one billion rupies...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
10
おく
ルピ……
わたくしの、
10おくルピがぁぁ……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
...We worked so hard together to rebuild it,
and now the plaza's in ruins again...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
せっかく、
街のみんなで直してた広場が、
またこんなことになっちゃうなんて……

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text:
There appear to be many injured, also.
We should assist however we can
to provide first aid and such to those who need it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……怪我をなさった方も、
多いようですね。
わたくしたちでも、
出来る限り
手当などのお手伝いをいたしましょう。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Mm, I agree... Huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだね……
あれっ？

text_block_list.name: Soldier 1
text_block_list.text:
Step aside, bystanders!
We are an elite guild in service to the Council of Nobles:
the Golden Hand!
text_block_list.orig_text:
野次馬ども、
どけどけ！
我々は
貴族議会直属治安維持ギルド、
【黄金の手】部隊である！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text:
Could they be...
soldiers from the palace, sent by Miss Pecorine to assist us?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれは……
ぺコリーヌさまが派遣してくださった、
王宮の兵士の方々でしょうか？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Geez... Get here sooner, why don't you?!
You're pretty high and mighty for latecomers!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ったく、
来るのが遅いってーの！
そのくせエラそーにしちゃってさ！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text:
Now now, Miss Karyl.
There is no need for such aggression.
They too are only trying to protect the populace...
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあまあ、
キャルさま。
あまり邪険にしないほうがよろしいかと。
彼らも、
街のみなさまを助けに参られたわけですし……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Wait... H-huh?
It looks like those soldiers are coming this way...
text_block_list.orig_text:
って……
あ、
あれ？
あの兵士さんたち、
あたしたちのほうに来るよ？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Do they want to ask us something?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ？
何か用なのかな？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Uhhh?
text_block_list.orig_text: えー？

text_block_list.name: Soldier 1
text_block_list.text: All of you! Drop your weapons!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前たち、
大人しくしろ！

text_block_list.name: Soldier 2
text_block_list.text:
If you come quietly, we won't have to hurt you!
But if you resist, your lives may be forfeit!
text_block_list.orig_text:
抵抗しなければ、
こちらも手荒な真似はせん！
だが暴れるようなら、
命の保証はないぞ！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Wha—?! Hey, what's the big idea here?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっ！　
ちょっと何なのよあんたたちっ！？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
We're surrounded?!
But why?! We were only fighting to protect this city!
text_block_list.orig_text:
囲まれた……！？
何故だ！　
私たちは、
街を守るために戦ったんだぞ！？

text_block_list.name: Soldier 1
text_block_list.text:
Don't talk back!
Objections will be taken as a sign of resistance!
text_block_list.orig_text:
問答無用だ！
騒ぐようなら、
それも抵抗と見なす！

text_block_list.name: Soldier 2
text_block_list.text:
Commander!
We have the suspects right here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
隊長！
確保しました、
こいつらです！

text_block_list.name: Commander
text_block_list.text:
Yes... very good!
That face matches the felon we were sent for!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うむ、
間違いない！
手配書にあった、
凶悪犯の顔だ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: F-felon?!
text_block_list.orig_text: 凶悪犯っ！？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Please, this has gotta be a mistake!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな、
何かの間違いだよっ！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Indeed. We would never...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうです、
わたくしたちは……！

text_block_list.name: Soldier 1
text_block_list.text: Hrmph! I told you, no objections!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええいっ、
問答無用と言ったはずだ！

text_block_list.name: Commander
text_block_list.text:
We will take the wanted felon and associates into custody!
Throw them into the palace dungeons!
text_block_list.orig_text:
では指名手配犯とその一味を、
まとめて束縛する！
王宮の地下牢に、連行しろっ！

text_block_list.name: Soldiers
text_block_list.text: Yessir!
text_block_list.orig_text: はっ！

text_block_list.name: All
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaaa?!
text_block_list.orig_text: ええええーっ！？
